description: Retrospective. primaryMuscleGroup and equipment on exercise, stamped from a curated catalog on exact case-insensitive name match only, never fuzzy: an unrecognised name stays untagged rather than guessed at. Drives mid-session substitute suggestions, ranked equipment-first, because you look for a substitute when the machine is taken. Tags are stamped on create only, so new catalog entries need their own backfill migration.
title: Muscle-group taxonomy and curated exercise catalog
